verdict.rationale: Codex supports delegating tasks to run in isolated cloud environments triggered from GitHub/GitLab/Linear/Slack, and running in parallel without tying up a local machine, which enables background-style autonomous task execution (codex-docs-1,3,6). However, there's no evidence of scheduled/triggered recurring 'automations' beyond ad-hoc task delegation, and community feedback raises concerns about sandboxing, file-system access trust, and reliability of autonomous operation (codex-comm-7, codex-comm-10).
